services.name: Christmas Regatta
services.desc: Join us as a Parade Participant for the 38th Annual Intracoastal Christmas Regatta parade along the Intracoastal Waterway on the Barefoot Queen Riverboat! Partnering with Toys for Tots, bring a toy with you and get $5 back on your ticket per toy (up to 2 toys per order)!! Full Meal and Christmas Treats will be served on this cruise along with games, prizes and entertainment for the evening! Get a front row seat to enjoy the Regatta and be a Parade Participant! We placed First last year and need your help to maintain the title! We are located at the Barefoot Marina ACROSS the waterway from Barefoot Landing. Boarding begins 45 minutes prior to departure time. We have limited disability
